names: the Eclipse Foundation's project archives (Eclipse Project Archives, archive.eclipse.org; Archived Projects, eclipse.org) (T1-3; B4, B8)
Eclipse Archives, an apparel brand (eclipsearchives.com; TikTok @eclipse_archives) (T1-4; B2, B7)
the Historical Eclipse Image Archive of the High Altitude Observatory (NCAR), on NASA's eclipse site (T1-5; B3)
Eclipse Marketplace archive plugins, the Eclipse Archive Utility and the Eclipse Zip Editor (T1-6; B5, B6)
homonyms.basis: A collision at the name (per_dim.reached 'collision'): the composition lists the archive as one of five things 'eclipse archive' means (T1-1), the archive first (CAP-1-02), the other four from seven of the eight cards (CAP-1-03, CAP-1-13). Each stays a distinct entity in the disambiguation, never a sense of the archive's name; the census keeps the archive apart by its name's homage to Sun & Moon (LS-33). The encyclopedia's 'Eclipse' disambiguation lists Eclipse Comics and Eclipse (software) and not the archive (F42).
distinct_entities: Craig Dworkin, the founding editor (B12; his conceptual writing in the archive's deposits, unadmitted here)
Danny Snelson, the editor; the index's 'Daniel Scott Snelson' (F28), not joined by the saved sources
Douglas Messerli's Sun & Moon press, the name's dedicatee (F36)
UbuWeb, PennSound and Jacket2, the census's neighbours (LS-34); UbuWeb and PennSound rows built in parallel
Eclipse Comics and Eclipse (software), on the encyclopedia's disambiguation (F42)

captures.description: THE NAME, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The term eclipse archive can refer to several distinct topics depending on the context:' Five bullets: 'Poetry & Digital Archives: The Eclipse Archive is a digital poetry publisher and archive founded by Craig Dworkin and edited by Danny Snelson, featuring out-of-print and avant-garde writing (such as Gnome Baker magazine)'; the Eclipse Foundation's project archives; 'Eclipse Archives', a streetwear brand of anime drops; NASA's Historical Eclipse Image Archive; Eclipse IDE archive tools. Eight cards: eclipsearchive.org, the brand's shop, NASA, the Eclipse Foundation (two), the Eclipse Marketplace (two), TikTok.
